name: oracle-gated-vault
description: Oracle-gated vault template: Supra/Pyth-style price band gates deposits and withdrawals on Hedera. Mock oracle for local DX; read-only live feed docs when testnet oracle is thin.

envVars.description: mock | read-only-live — local default is mock (no keys)
Optional Pyth/Supra feed id for read-only live mode

steps.label: Compile + unit tests (no keys)
steps.command: npm run hardhat:compile && npm run hardhat:test

steps.text: OWNER: fund testnet via portal.hedera.com faucet, then deploy --network hederaTestnet and attach Hashscan link. Do not commit .env.
Read docs/ORACLE_ADAPTERS.md and docs/TESTNET_VERIFICATION.md before live testnet. Never commit .env or fabricate Hashscan URLs.
